description: Read one provider performance bond by its id, which is keyless, or list the bonds one wallet has committed, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make, oldest first. For each: the service it names, the NET it names, open, withdrawn or expired, and whether the wallet covers it, by a balance read at most 30 seconds earlier (covered or uncovered). To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held and nothing can take it: a bond is a record, never custody and never a lock. Free; a read by id is keyless, and a list is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

bondId.description: The bond's id (the bondId it was committed under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a provider, to list its bonds. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_bond_status
title: Where a provider performance bond stands, or every bond one wallet has committed (a signed read)
